Full-time, contract-based role 12 months, with a view to extending
Available now
 
We’re looking for a Senior React Developer to join a front-end team in creating and maintaining a rebuild of a software platform end-to-end, using best-practice methodologies to exceed client and user expectations.
 
You will like to implement modern and complex designs, working closely with the UX and UI team to solve complex problems.. You will be able to translate design animations into beautiful, performant website animations.
 
You will have developed a high level of knowledge of best-in-class web-based experiences from design-driven, seamless solutions, AI-first development and how to get the best from AI tools,  bringing technical optimisation, performance and page speed, allowing revenue to flow seamlessly.
 
You will work in small but perfectly formed pods to rapidly develop and deploy websites, manage code repositories, set up best practice deployments, and be familiar with hosting and domain configuration.  And yes, you’ll have developed a good level of business acumen and can keep your eye on a few plates as they spin, and still crack the odd joke along the way.
